note: Machine-readable engagement policy, enforced by engine/pacing.py — NOT prose. min_interval_seconds is a GLOBAL budget across the whole target set, not per host. If the program publishes a rate cap, stay well under it; if it publishes nothing, leave this conservative default. Put any header the program mandates on every request into required_headers with its real value (e.g. {"X-Bug-Bounty": "yourlogin"}) — a value of "TODO" or "" makes poc_runtime refuse to fire, which is the intended behaviour until you fill it in.
